supersedes: prospective-blind-v2 8-field scientific list (ee_percent, yield_percent, h2_pressure_bar, temperature_c, reaction_time_h, solvent, ligand, substrate_class)
PR #20 documentation 8 high-level fields (reaction, catalyst, ligand, substrate, product, conditions, yield, selectivity)
selectivity_option_note: Selectivity is split into a numeric enantioselectivity field and a separate stereochemical outcome field. A compound 'selectivity' field is not scored.

fields.name: reaction
fields.definition: The transformation performed in this candidate, as a controlled reaction type (for example asymmetric hydrogenation of a C=O, C=N or C=C bond).
fields.canonicalization: controlled vocabulary defined by benchmark/REACTION_TAXONOMY_V1.json (label form <reaction_type>.<substrate_class>); case-insensitive exact match
fields.evidence_requirement: the reaction type must be stated or unambiguously named in the bound evidence window

fields.name: catalyst
fields.definition: Metal precursor or isolated precatalyst used for this candidate reaction.
fields.canonicalization: exact string match after whitespace and case normalization; no structure inference in v1.0
fields.evidence_requirement: named in the bound evidence window

fields.name: ligand
fields.definition: Chiral ligand used for this candidate reaction.
fields.canonicalization: modules/ligand_resolver.py canonical_id; paper-local aliases resolve only from an explicit in-source definition
fields.evidence_requirement: mention in the bound evidence window plus, for an alias, an explicit definition in the same source document

fields.name: substrate
fields.definition: Substrate of this candidate reaction, as named or as its class when the source gives only a class.
fields.canonicalization: exact string match after normalization; class-level answers are scored against class-level gold only
fields.evidence_requirement: named in the bound evidence window

fields.name: product
fields.evidence_requirement: named in the bound evidence window

fields.name: h2_pressure
fields.definition: Molecular hydrogen pressure for this candidate reaction.
fields.canonicalization: converted to bar only when the source unit is explicit (bar, atm, psi, MPa, kPa); tolerance abs 5e-4
fields.evidence_requirement: value and unit present in the bound evidence window

fields.name: temperature
fields.canonicalization: numeric, tolerance abs 1e-4; a non-numeric report such as room temperature is not coerced and is recorded as not_reported_numerically
fields.evidence_requirement: value present in the bound evidence window

fields.name: reaction_time
fields.canonicalization: numeric, tolerance abs 1e-4; minutes converted only when the unit is explicit
fields.evidence_requirement: value present in the bound evidence window

fields.name: solvent
fields.canonicalization: controlled solvent vocabulary, case-insensitive; mixtures are recorded verbatim and scored as a single string
fields.evidence_requirement: named in the bound evidence window

fields.name: yield
fields.definition: Reported yield for this candidate reaction.
fields.canonicalization: numeric 0-100, tolerance abs 1e-4; conversion is not yield and is recorded as not_applicable for this field
fields.evidence_requirement: value present in the bound evidence window

fields.name: ee_or_er
fields.definition: Enantioselectivity as reported: either ee in percent or er as a ratio.
fields.canonicalization: the reported kind is preserved; er is converted to ee only when the ratio is explicit and unambiguous; tolerance abs 1e-4 after conversion
fields.evidence_requirement: value present in the bound evidence window

fields.name: stereochemical_outcome
fields.definition: Absolute configuration or the designated major enantiomer, when the source states it.
fields.canonicalization: controlled tokens R, S, (R), (S), and source-specific descriptors preserved verbatim; never inferred from the ee value
fields.evidence_requirement: stated in the bound evidence window

value_states.answered: a value was produced and is scoreable
value_states.not_reported: the source does not report this field for this reaction; gold is null and a null prediction is correct abstention
value_states.not_applicable: the field cannot exist for this reaction type; excluded from all denominators
value_states.unresolved: an identity or value was mentioned but could not be resolved from the source; excluded from coverage, never counted as incorrect
value_states.ambiguous: the source supports more than one mutually exclusive reading; excluded from coverage, never counted as incorrect

value_state_rules: unresolved does not count toward answer coverage
ambiguous is not incorrect and does not count toward answer coverage
not_applicable is removed from every denominator
not_reported with a null prediction is a correct abstention, not an answer
a null prediction against a non-null gold is a miss, not an error of value

schema_amendments.change: the reaction field now cites REACTION_TAXONOMY_V1 as its controlled vocabulary
